Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made the critical error at Step 4 by issuing an instruction to WebSurfer to "check the content of the PDF file" from `sweetpotatoknowledge.org`. At this point in the conversation, the Orchestrator explicitly recognized in previous turns (Step 3) that access to this specific PDF was blocked by security checks (CAPTCHA) and that the agent was stuck in a loop of failed access attempts. By directing WebSurfer to attempt accessing this known-inaccessible resource again, the Orchestrator failed to adhere to its own "New Plan" to "Reduce Dependence on Document Access" and instead perpetuated the failure, leading directly to the premature termination of the task without finding the solution.
